name: bollinger_ema_sar_v1_1
purpose: Change only the market-slope / sideways filter from v1; keep every other rule identical.
unchanged_from_v1: rocket rejection wick >=70% of body or body engulfing
signal low higher than prior low for LONG / signal high lower than prior high for SHORT
stop at low/high of candle immediately before signal candle

market_regime_filter_v1_1.goal: Operate if and only if there is directional slope; reject the flattest regime without requiring every one-minute EMA20 step to be monotonic.
market_regime_filter_v1_1.sideways_threshold: 25th percentile of slope strength over the prior 60 closed bars, shifted one bar so the threshold never uses the current observation
market_regime_filter_v1_1.trade_rule: Correct slope direction AND current slope_strength > prior rolling Q25; otherwise NO_TRADE
market_regime_filter_v1_1.optimization: NONE; Q25, 60 bars and 3-bar slope are fixed before this run

comparison: v1 strict 3-step monotonic EMA20 vs v1.1 adaptive directional slope. Judge on sample size, expectancy, PF, drawdown, direction and pattern distribution; do not select by win rate alone.
